<!-- pr-reviewer: 8430093d8f3bd887289ef30d277a64122e1919ce -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The fix is correct. The PR changes the line endings of three files, and that must go.

**What looks good**
- `outward()` now returns `Err(reason)` and never guesses a side. A face with an unknown outside gets `normal: null`, `facing: null` and `outside_unknown: <reason>`. The listing does not fail. This is what #2186 asks for ("facing and normal null, or a flag with outward_normal's reason").
- I reverted `crates/app/src/mcp/features.rs` to main and ran the new test. `an_open_shell_face_says_its_outside_is_unknown` FAILS on the old code (the face shows `"facing":"up","normal":[0,0,1]`). `a_closed_box_keeps_its_outward_normals` passes on both. The open-shell test therefore pins the fix.
- Consumers: no code in `crates/*/src` reads the `facing` or `normal` of a face row. The MCP tools and script verbs take face ids and call `outward_normal` themselves. They refuse an open shell by name, as before. Only tests read these fields, and they pass. A refusal stays a refusal.
- The `camcraft-mcp` skill replaces the #937 caveat with the new field. `PROCESS_VERSION` is not edited and the body has `Process change: yes`.

**Results** (locally, trial-merged with `origin/main`, `-j 6`, no runner used)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `mcp_list_features_outside` | 2 passed |
| `mcp_wcs_features` | 2 passed |
| `mcp_lay_face` | 1 passed |
| `mcp_pick` | 7 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. Line endings. The PR turns three files from LF to CRLF. A diff against main shows 472 + 562 + 598 changed lines, but only 4 + 30 + 4 lines really change:
   - `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` (main has 0 CR bytes, the PR has 236)
   - `crates/app/src/mcp/features.rs` (281 CR bytes)
   - `crates/app/tests/mcp_wcs_features.rs` (299 CR bytes)

   This hides the real change, breaks `git blame` and conflicts with every open PR that touches these files. Convert the three files back to LF (for example `git checkout origin/main -- <file>` and re-apply the small edits) and push. `git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD` must then show about 4, 30 and 4 lines.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The new `Ok(None)` arm gives the reason "<face> of '<model>' is not a flat face". The existing tests pass, so no current face row takes it. Please say in the PR body if a curved-wall face can reach it.
- A closed face row now carries `"outside_unknown": null`. This is fine for agents. The skill text could say "absent or null".
- The T-junction plate of the issue was not run (the PR says so). An open shell by a dropped facet takes the same `outward_normal` refusal path.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 61c161e5e015a6658ac61745172b88316ff9150a -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a delta review of the one new commit `61c161e5e`, `fix(mcp): restore LF line endings`.

Readings, all by git (no build):
- `git diff -w --ignore-cr-at-eol 8430093d8 61c161e5e` is empty. The commit changes line endings only.
- The three files from the earlier request now have 0 CR bytes: `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, `crates/app/src/mcp/features.rs`, `crates/app/tests/mcp_wcs_features.rs`. The new test file `crates/app/tests/mcp_list_features_outside.rs` has 0 CR bytes too.
- `git diff origin/main...61c161e5e --stat` shows only the real change: 4 files, 109 insertions, 19 deletions. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is not touched.
- `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` is clean. GitHub reports the PR as MERGEABLE.
- The body has `Process change: yes` and a `Changelog:` line.

The build, test and clippy readings of the earlier review (head `8430093d8`) stay valid. The content is the same, and only the line endings differ.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
